hypotheses: H1: Cross-system transfer is real for these compounds, so a second line in a different tissue will often reproduce the first activity label; source choice matters (S1).

H2: Shared systematic response or database annotation inflates apparent agreement, so second-line labels may reflect batch/vehicle-threshold artifacts rather than compound-specific transfer (S2, S4, S5).
evidence_gaps: No measured second-line activity labels are provided yet; only available lines and first_line are known.
Targets and MOA annotations are not causal evidence and may be incomplete or tissue-dependent (S3, S4).
Activity is a vehicle-norm threshold in L1000, not viability; mechanism cannot be inferred from two labels (S5).
No information on which second line maximizes one active and one inactive record per compound.
